anti_overlap: Owns the SEQUENCE as a whole object — variety, recurrence spacing, topic run-length, tier ratio, obligated placement, and the notability taxonomy R12 implies; the horology lens owns the MECHANISM — accumulation, gating, transmission, and threshold release — and does not adjudicate whether the resulting year reads as varied.

Frames GATE 1 as a question about how many distinguishable topics the year retains; the horology lens frames the same gate as a question about which reservoir carries load and whether it can express upstream variation. Both may reach opposite recommendations; each must argue in its own primitives.

Frames GATE 2's double-count as 'the same material entering the sequence twice in adjacent positions'; the horology lens owns the arithmetic reconciliation of two drive paths on one output and the invalidation of the design doc's condition table. This lens must not attempt the numeric re-derivation.

Reasons in verses, links, shifts, seasons, topics, seats, aversions, and pacing movements; the horology lens reasons in barrels, trains, gating, torque, escapement release, warning runs, and rate regulation — no shared primitive vocabulary.
decision_lens: Would a sosho accept this year as a completed sequence — or reject it for sarikirai violation (the same material recurring with nothing between), for stalling in jo with no ha (52 weeks, no arrival, no death, no refusal), for an all-ji surface (every event ground-tier, nothing designed), for a topic given unlimited run-length (a spiral that stops shifting), or for a code whose aversion rules cannot fire on any verse that actually occurs? Rank by whether the flaw makes a varied sequence structurally impossible (P0), guarantees a slack year that only tuning-by-luck rescues (P1), degrades the reading (P2), or is diction polish (P3).
distance_rationale: A pre-modern, non-Western literary craft refined over six centuries has no causal relationship to Rust simulation architecture, yet it is precisely the discipline of producing a LONG SEQUENCE with guaranteed variety and a felt arc out of many semi-autonomous contributors whom the master steers only indirectly. Every measured symptom in RaveNous is a fault renga already names and forbids: identical material recurring with nothing between it (132 toasts), a sequence that never leaves its quiet opening (a year with zero deaths and zero arrivals), a code whose aversion rules cannot fire on any verse that occurs (the refusal conjunction), a single topic granted unlimited run-length (the spiral ruling), and a master with no lever that reaches the verses (dispatch cannot reach a refusing bird). It is not on the banned list and shares no parent discipline with mechanical horology.
expected_isomorphisms: 132 identical toasts across a shipped year <-> a sarikirai violation: the same material recurring without the required intervening verses, which the code treats as a technical fault of the composition, not a tuning preference
PAUSE / TOAST / SILENT interrupt tiers <-> the ji/mon plain-versus-design ratio, where an all-ground sequence is inert and design verses must be SPACED, not merely triggered

'the spiral IS the danger' (last goal's ruling) <-> a single topic held past its permitted run-length: linked verse judges a runaway theme as the sequence having stopped shifting, i.e. a failure of linking rather than a climax

a 52-week year with zero deaths and zero arrivals <-> a hyakuin stuck in jo that never reaches ha; the craft answer is obligated feature seats (the moon MUST appear here) layered on top of emergence, not more emergence
the player's single verb, dispatch, unable to reach a refusing bird <-> the sosho who can only accept and place verses: when the code produces nothing placeable, the master's authority is nominal

R12 vocabulary-agnostic substrate <-> shikimoku stated over topic categories: spacing rules cannot be enforced by a code that knows no categories, so some minimal notability/recurrence taxonomy must live in the engine or no pacing invariant is possible for any vocabulary
focus: Whether a shipped 52-week year composes as a SEQUENCE with felt variety, controlled recurrence, and an arc — or whether the proposed health-accumulator collapses four distinguishable failure topics into one, deepening the measured monotone (132 identical toasts, zero arrivals, zero refusals) instead of curing it. Owns notability, tier assignment (PAUSE/TOAST/SILENT), obligatory-feature placement vs. pure emergence, and where the taxonomy that makes any of it enforceable can live given R12.
name: fd-renga-pacing-and-recurrence
persona: Apply the perspective of a master of Japanese linked verse (renga / haikai no renga) working under the classical shikimoku codes — the centuries-refined craft of assembling a 36-verse kasen or 100-verse hyakuin from many hands into one sequence that must never go slack. This craft reasons about: sarikirai (aversion rules fixing how many verses must intervene before the same material, season, or figure may recur), link-and-shift (each verse must connect to the one before it and move AWAY from the one before that, so the sequence never circles back on itself), the ji/mon ratio (plain ground verses versus design verses, and the fault of a sequence that is all ground — inert — or all design — exhausting), fixed feature positions (tsuki no za and hana no za: the moon and the blossom are OBLIGATED to appear at specified places, not left to inspiration), jo-ha-kyu pacing (a quiet opening, a developing middle that must actually develop, a quick close), the permitted run-length of a single topic (love, travel, and grief each may hold only so many consecutive verses before the sequence is judged to have stalled), and the sosho's position — a master who steers the sequence only by the code and by which verse is accepted where, never by writing the verses. It judges a finished sequence as a whole object: whether it moved, whether anything recurred that should not have, and whether the rules that were supposed to guarantee movement were ever capable of firing.
review_areas: The monotone as a recurrence fault, not a tuning miss: 132 identical toasts and zero arrivals/refusals across 52 weeks is a sequence with no aversion rule and no obligated feature. Judge whether the design anywhere states how often the same KIND of event may recur, whether distinct event kinds even exist in quantity, and whether the fix the goal proposes (danger via health) adds kinds or removes them.

Topic collapse under a single accumulator: four needs are four topics a year can shift between (a thirst stretch, a hunger stretch, an injury stretch, a listlessness stretch, each reading differently); routing every hardship through health makes one topic recur unboundedly. Interrogate whether GATE 1's 'health becomes the sole death path' buys danger at the cost of the only variety the sim has, and whether keeping food lethal is really a redundancy question or a topic-count question.

Tier assignment as the ji/mon ratio: PAUSE / TOAST / SILENT is a plain-versus-design distinction, and the measured year is all-ji with a single design gesture repeated 132 times. Examine whether tier membership is decided by event KIND (a fixed rule) or by state crossing a threshold, whether the design-2026-06-20-df-feel-depth ruling 'log structured events always, render prose rarely' was ever built as an actual signal/noise filter, and whether the PAUSE tier fires on any situation the player's one verb can answer.

Placed obligation versus pure emergence: renga does not leave the moon to inspiration — it fixes the seats where it must appear. The goal's DONE WHEN asks a year to produce 'at least one death or one interrupt I could have acted on' but the whole mechanism proposed is emergent hazard. Assess whether the year needs obligated features (a hard season at a fixed span, a recruitment arrival, a molt, a rival) as a separate layer from need-pressure, and what that implies for the vertical-slice ordering.

The spiral as a runaway topic: linked verse treats a single theme that keeps escalating with no shift as a failure of linking, not a climax. Test the last goal's ruling 'the spiral IS the danger' against this — once condition begins to floor, does the year produce a sequence of differing events (the bird refuses, another bird covers, a ground is abandoned, a bond frays) or a monotone descent whose only reading is the same verse louder? GATE 2's double-count is the sharpest form of this question.

Where the taxonomy lives (R12): shikimoku is stated over topic CATEGORIES — spring, love, moon, travel — so a code that knows no categories can enforce no spacing. Judge whether a vocabulary-agnostic animal-sim that holds no semantics can guarantee ANY pacing property, what minimal category surface (need-kind classes, event-notability classes, recurrence keys) the substrate must own for pacing to be enforceable in an octopus game too, and whether raven-vocab currently holds semantics the substrate needs back.
severity_examples: P0: GATE 1 resolved as 'health is the sole lethal need' reduces the year's failure vocabulary from four distinguishable topics to one, so every bad outcome renders as the same material — the measured 132-identical-toast fault reproduced one layer deeper and now load-bearing, since the goal's own OUTCOME depends on the player reading a decline. A single accumulator is the correct place to ROUTE damage and the wrong place to NAME it; if the naming surface is not split from the accumulation surface before this lands, no toast tuning can restore variety.

P1: the year has no obligated features at all — 52 weeks produced zero arrivals as well as zero deaths, meaning nothing is scheduled to happen, only permitted to. Emergent hazard alone cannot satisfy DONE WHEN except by luck of calibration; the design needs a placed-feature layer (a hard season, an arrival, a scheduled encounter) stated independently of need-pressure, or every future goal will keep re-tuning drains to manufacture events that placement should supply.

P2: the refusal predicate is a conjunction whose second term is satisfied 13 times against the first's 986, so it is a rule that cannot fire — and because a refusing bird refuses every ground alike, the one PAUSE-tier situation the design imagines is unanswerable by dispatch, the player's only verb. A rule that cannot fire and a verse the master cannot place are the same fault: the code does not reach the sequence it is supposed to govern.
source_domain: Japanese linked-verse composition (renga and haikai no renga) under the classical shikimoku codes — sarikirai recurrence-spacing, link-and-shift, the ji/mon plain-versus-design ratio, obligated feature seats (tsuki no za, hana no za), permitted topic run-lengths, jo-ha-kyu pacing, and the sosho who steers a many-handed sequence without writing it.
success_hints: Run crates/ravenous-session/src/bin/how_close_is_it.rs and what_a_year_says.rs / what_the_player_sees.rs, then count DISTINCT event and toast KINDS, not counts — the diagnostic number for this lens is the size of the vocabulary of things that can happen, and how many of them occurred at least once in the shipped year.

Read docs/design-2026-06-20-df-feel-depth.md's 'log structured events always, render prose rarely' principle and its four-layer build order, then check the code for whether any signal/noise filter exists at all; if the toast path renders every occurrence of one kind, the ji/mon distinction was never implemented and the tier canon in ravenous-vision.md sec 7 is aspirational.

Walk the 52-week year as a 52-verse sequence and mark each week as ground or design; then mark topic run-lengths (how many consecutive weeks the same need is the dominant pressure — water is under 7000 for 59% of the year, which is a topic held far past any permitted run). Report the longest run and whether anything in the design could ever break it.

Test GATE 1 and GATE 2 by asking what each resolution does to the COUNT of distinguishable readable situations, not to the death rate; state explicitly which resolution preserves more topics and whether that conflicts with the goal's own recommendation.

Read scripts/check-agnosticism.sh and crates/animal-sim/src/vocab.rs and needs.rs to establish exactly what the substrate is forbidden to know, then name the minimal category surface (recurrence keys, notability classes) that would let animal-sim enforce a pacing invariant for any vocabulary — and say whether adding it violates R12 or completes it.

Read the interrupt-tier canon revision in ravenous-vision.md sec 7 (R2/R3: PAUSE / TOAST / SILENT, no player knobs in v1) and judge whether the tiers are a legibility device or a pacing device; if they are pacing, they need spacing rules, and no spacing rule is written anywhere.
